claims.text: Combining GPT-3 with expert-drafted codebooks achieves fair to substantial agreement with expert-coded results in deductive coding tasks.

evidence.description: Using a curiosity-driven questions coding task as a case study, combining GPT-3 with expert-drafted codebooks achieved fair to substantial agreements with expert-coded results.

methodologies.name: LLM-assisted deductive coding via prompt learning
methodologies.description: Utilizing pre-trained GPT-3 directly with expert-drafted codebooks to perform deductive qualitative coding without fine-tuning.

limitations.text: Traditional qualitative analysis of textual contents is labor-intensive, particularly when working with large datasets.
Existing task-specific AI tools for qualitative analysis suffer from limited generalizability and require specialized AI resources and expertise.

future_work.text: Addressing key challenges and exploring opportunities in applying LLMs to support qualitative coding and broader qualitative analysis tasks.
